title: Show HN: TikZ Editor – WYSIWYG editor for figures in LaTeX
summary: A WYSIWYG editor for TikZ (LaTeX vector graphics package) that provides real-time visual editing, eliminating the traditional cycle of hand-coding coordinates and repeatedly recompiling to preview results.
problem_solved: Eliminates the tedious trial-and-error workflow of manually coding TikZ figures and recompiling LaTeX documents for each visual adjustment.
why_valuable: Significantly improves productivity for academics and researchers creating technical figures by providing instant visual feedback during the editing process.
